categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet state management in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where upgrading a coin lock from non-persistent to persistent leaves a stale locked UTXO record in the database after the coin is spent and the wallet reloads. As described in the PR, 'upgrading an existing non-persistent lock to a persistent lock used emplace() without updating the existing value', causing 'UnlockCoin() therefore did not erase the persistent LOCKED_UTXO database record'.
